keys.encoding: raw 32-byte public key, standard Base64 with padding
keys.scope: All benthic.io BDP manifests and collections.

notes: author_pubkey is the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key in standard Base64. It is not an ssh-ed25519 wire-format blob and not a PEM SubjectPublicKeyInfo. See https://benthic.io/bdp/ for the full specification.
